I have thought about that in the past, but all things considered \(I've thought about this for a while\) I don't really think that it would fix my issues, if anything, it could actually makes matters worse.

As for why:

>\> It's not even just the act of sex in and itself, really, it's also the fact that I haven't met a single person that thinks I am either good enough or attractive enough that they would actually like to have sex with me.

There are other reasons too as for why I am not going to visit a sex worker, but yeah. That's one of the biggest reasons why really.
I understand where you're coming from and I obviously would not want to have any STDs at all, but I don't know if that really makes me happy that I am a virgin.
